globalRequirements: Every frame is a complete painted full-body unit frame, not a separated limb composite.
Costume language must combine Napoleonic-era military tailoring with Ming-dynasty Chinese details.
All units keep a Chinese topknot or Chinese military headwear unless their role explicitly needs a helmet.
Frames use a flat #00ff00 chroma-key background, no text, no watermark, no frame numbers.
Move animations must include contact, down, passing/overlap, lift, opposite contact, and return poses.
Attack animations must include guard, wind-up, strike, impact/follow-through, and post-attack stance.
Hit animations must include impact, recoil, stagger, and unstable end pose.
Recover animations must visibly return from off-balance/post-action pose to normal guard stance.
Defeat animations must show loss of balance, kneel or collapse, fall, and final defeated silhouette.
